paper_title: New solar X-ray constraints on keV Axion-Like Particles
suggested_experiment_name: Solar trapped ALPs X-ray (SphinX + NuSTAR, photon coalescence)
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1, as plotted on the y-axis of Fig. 1
notes: Paper derives new exclusion limits on g_agamma vs m for keV ALPs (3-40 keV) from decays of gravitationally trapped solar ALPs, using SphinX and NuSTAR solar X-ray data with photon-coalescence production (improving prior DeRocco et al. limits by ~1 order of magnitude). No numerical table is provided; limits appear only in Fig. 1/4 with y-axis spanning 1e-13 to 1e-9 GeV^-1. The data_points are APPROXIMATE reconstructions inferred from: (a) the stated one-order-of-magnitude improvement over DeRocco et al. (~few x 1e-12), (b) the benchmark g_agamma = 6e-13 GeV^-1 used in Fig. 2, and (c) the stated validity range 3-40 keV. Values should be replaced by digitized figure data if precision is needed. Hadronic case (g_ae = 0) taken as the primary limit. Explicitly does NOT assume ALPs are the local dark matter, so dm_density_assumed is null.
